title: The Fingerprint Whorl
youtube_title: The Fingerprint Whorl | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Kavi finds a fingerprint whorl in flour on the table. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Kavi shows Cleo how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
